overview: Mexican TV-show about Mexican comedian Eugenio Derbez playing different characters.

overview: A Woman named Maria de todos los Angeles is finding love. Until she meets a man named Albertano who may be the love of her life. But their relationship is complicated when Albertano family does not approve of Maria de todos Los Angeles
title: María de todos los Ángeles

overview: Four high school students from different backgrounds run their school radio station while juggling academic, family, and social lives. Their clashing personalities create electric, explosive situations leading to humor.

overview: A therapy group led by Dr. Guillermo Segura (Jorge Marrale) is the meeting point of several patients with different problems.

overview: After her death, Ruhsar returns as a ghost to be with his husband Mazhar, but she must use her magical abilities to protect their happiness from Mazhar's mother, who is unaware of Ruhsar's presence, makes her best to remarry his son with another woman.
title: Ruhsar

overview: Nana, the daughter of a golf course tycoon, is suddenly called back from studying fashion in Europe to save the business from crisis. There, she meets Pro Vee, a former skilled golf pro who is now the resident golf pro. Pro Vee is strict, demanding, and displeased that Nana knows nothing about golf, the sport she loves and is so dedicated to. The two must cooperate to save Nana's father's golf course,leading to a deep and romantic relationship. However, things aren't as simple as they should be. A major obstacle hindering Nana and Pro Vee's goals is Pro Jin, another highly skilled golf pro from a rival golf course. This often leads to verbal clashes with Belle, Nana's father's secretary, who is sent to assist and be Nana's right-hand woman.
title: Fairway of Love

overview: Ámbar dreams of knowing her father, but what she has not realized is that her father's image is closer than she believes.
title: Ámbar

overview: Follow Eli Stone on his quirky quest for answers in this exciting and upbeat comedic drama. When Eli awakens to an unending George Michael soundtrack that only he can hear, gets dive-bombed by a WWI biplane on a busy San Francisco street, and faces a fire-breathing dragon outside his office window, there are two possible explanations: delusions caused by a potentially fatal brain aneurysm or the chance that something greater is at work. He might just be a prophet sent to change the world.
title: Eli Stone

overview: Barbarians Rising tells the epic saga of the rise and fall of the Roman Empire from the perspective of the barbarian leaders who brought it down; a high-impact, visceral journey into the heart of their rebellions against absolute power. The Roman Empire called them "barbarians" – tribes beyond the fringe of civilization that live a primitive, savage existence. But they are also some of the fiercest warriors in history – men and women who rose up to resist so that they might live free, or die. The four-part docu-drama reveals the true story of the 700-year battle for supremacy, a fight for freedom that would shape the world to come. Featuring fully dramatized portrayals of icons including Hannibal, Spartacus, Arminius, Boudica and Attila alongside an eclectic group of experts and contributors, Barbarians Rising reveals the true history behind the legends.
title: Barbarians Rising

overview: After being fired from her job and dumped by her boyfriend, a cosmetics saleswoman becomes the nanny to the three children of a rich widow man. As time passes, the two fall for each other.
title: Dadi

overview: Aleks, Raivo, Marek and Toomas are modern-day men and fathers who face unexpected parenting challenges. Each of them solves the situations very differently, but together they successfully bring out the good and the bad of the modern parent. The stories of four friends are alive and definitely recognizable - there is also a lover, a breakup and other difficult relationship problems. How do men cope with all this?
title: Papsid

overview: A woman decides to work as nanny in the house of a rich theater director and his three children.
title: Η Νταντά

overview: Kifissia, 1925. Petros Aslanoglou arrives at the Grand Hotel to visit his sister, who works there. Discovering she's been missing for over a month, he goes undercover as a waiter to investigate, soon finding himself in grave danger.
title: Grand Hotel

overview: An ordinary man and single father is about to see himself as an object of affection to hundreds of women after he accepts an unusual business proposition from his cousin.

overview: Tichi Achondo new status forces her to move from her super mansion in La Dehesa to a semi-detached house in a middle-class neighborhood.

overview: The experiences of the members of the Fierro family are narrated: Martín, the father; Lucía, the mother; Juan, who is blind and a teacher; Sandy, a showgirl; and Ezequiel, a street boy whom the family adopted.

overview: Young journalist Feriha faces personal challenges while attempting to depict the violent era of 70s Turkey.

overview: When the brutally murdered mother of drug addict Alina (30) is found on the beach one day, the question arises whether Alina is a coldblooded manipulator or a lifelong victim of abuse.

overview: After her husband's death in 1942, a widow struggles to raise her five daughters on Mount Olympus, while years later changing lives and marriages pull the family away from their shared home.

overview: Sres. Papis chronicles the experiences of Favio "Chori" Carbonetti, Ignacio Moreno, Franco Bertossi, and Mauro De Leone—four attractive, modern dads who become friends through daily conversations at the school gate where their children attend preschool. Beyond supporting one another through the challenges and ups and downs of fatherhood, they find themselves drawn into each other's personal lives.
title: Sres. Papis

overview: Tahsim Durgun embarks on the ultimate journey across Germany together with a Kurdish aunt who represents the generation of Tahsim's mother—a road trip spanning everything from high culture to hobby horsing, and from rural farms to the party scene of Ballermann. Along the way, he discovers that Germany is a multifaceted country, yet also one full of contradictions. Amidst the regulations governing allotment gardens and the roar of football stadiums, Tahsim attempts to introduce his Aunt Zeynep to the country.
title: Deutschland, ich küss‘ dein Herz

overview: Forced to reinvent herself, Techi moves with her mother and daughters to a modest middle-class neighborhood. There, she meets Manuel "El Tiburón" Gallardo, a single father and fish market trader; although they initially clash due to their cultural differences, an unexpected romance inevitably begins to blossom amidst the chaos and family comedy.
title: Pituca sin lucas

overview: Set in contemporary London, Hard Sun centers on detectives Robert Hicks and Elaine Renko, partners and enemies who seek to enforce the law and protect their loved ones in a world that every day slips closer to certain destruction. Hicks is a family man and a great, committed officer. He's also profoundly corrupt. Renko is a difficult and damaged, but utterly incorruptible officer. Thus, the two cops stand on different ends of the social and moral spectrum and also seriously distrust one other – and for good reason. But they must somehow learn to work together if they're going to survive until the end of the world.
title: Hard Sun

overview: Nicolás Pérez de Castro, sick of stress, suddenly must go to the countryside to heal his illness.
title: Pobre Gallo

overview: The series narrates the stories of sex that the common denominator of the people lives but does not dare to tell publicly. Focused on two young couples, through their marital stories and those of their other ties, the series presents a wide range of themes in terms of sex: infidelities, homosexuality, fantasies, swingers, parallel relationships, sexual inhibitions, frigidity, etc.
title: Historias de sexo de gente común

overview: Andy and the Band take on their new roles as teachers at Rock Star School but soon realise this is no ordinary school.
title: Andy and the Band: Rock Star School

overview: Two good friends join the underground world of drug trafficking to make quick money and improve their lifestyles.
title: El cártel de los sapos

overview: An office romantic comedy that follows the story of a conglomerate heir and his new secretary, a former special forces officer now working undercover. Yun I Jun is a quirky third-generation chaebol raised in a sheltered environment who becomes a prime suspect in the mysterious murder of his previous secretary. When a new "male" secretary arrives to take the position, he has no idea that she's hiding a major secret. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae Hui, a former special forces officer turned police officer renowned as a "human weapon" for her exceptional strength and combat skills, disguises herself as a man and goes undercover as Yun I Jun's personal secretary and bodyguard. While protecting him, she secretly investigates him, setting the stage for unexpected chemistry, hidden identities, and plenty of comedic tension.
title: Love in Disguise

overview: Bruno, a widower and strict marine with 4 children, find love in a charismatic woman.
title: Papá a la Deriva

overview: Martín is faced with the challenge of raising his children alone, but he realizes that they also need a mother in their lives.

overview: A single arbitrator who lives in Buenos Aires, where he unexpectedly is visited by his three nephews who lived in the village of Capitán Gómez, and his life changed forever.

overview: An idealistic man unknown to the townspeople is accused of murder. To avenge his name he pretends to be the priest and discovers a story full of betrayals and misery.
title: Padre Coraje

overview: A family father struggles in maintaining lifelong relationships with three of his growing children ,after he divorced with his wife. In the unique Çengelköy district Fikret struggles with life, beside love, pain, hope.

overview: The funny story of the Çitir Family and those around this family.

overview: Minamida Minami, who has autism spectrum disorder (ASD), graduates at the top of her class from the University of Tokyo's Faculty of Law and also achieves the highest score on the bar examination. However, when she begins searching for a job, she runs up against the barrier of society's prejudice toward people with autism spectrum disorder. Despite her outstanding credentials, she is unable to secure a position at any law firm. Then, for a certain reason, she is hired by Hirokawa & Howard Law Firm, one of the top firms in the industry. However, because Minami has difficulty reading other people's emotions and communicating with them, as well as adapting to unexpected situations, those around her view her with prejudice, believing that there is no way she could possibly deal directly with clients. Minami herself is also uncertain whether she is capable of working as a lawyer. Even so, armed with her love of the law and her extraordinary memory, and with the help of her colleagues, she takes on one difficult case after another. At the same time, a succession of events that profoundly shake Minami's life awaits her, including experiencing romantic feelings for the first time and discovering secrets hidden within her family....
title: Extraordinary Attorney Minami

overview: Ali is a lovable rogue who prioritises his family. The 40 thieves, led by their leader Iblis, the devil incarnate himself, were suppressed by Ali's father, the great Jadugar Mustafa, and will remain so until two halves of a magical pendant unite. When the guardian of the cave, Simsim, embarks on a mission to resurrect the thieves, it is up to Ali, who holds one half of the magic pendant, to discover the magician within himself & realise his true purpose in life.
title: Alibaba: Dastaan-E-Kabul

overview: Brothers Arcadio and Santiago fight for control over their family's tequila empire. Arcadio marries Azul, who Santiago loves, to gain inheritance. Their wedding is interrupted by a peasant revolution, and Azul is kidnapped by gangsters.
title: Azul tequila

overview: Marisela Ocampo is a wealthy, beautiful, and intelligent young woman who feels a great void in her life, but then she meets Fernando Silva, a good, honest man from a respectable family. The two fall in love, but their families oppose the relationship: on one side is Marisela's father, Miguel, who considers Fernando beneath his daughter and wants something better for her; on the other is Mercedes, Fernando's sister, who harbors an unhealthy love for her own brother and refuses to see him happy with any woman; and to make matters worse, Paola, Marisela's sister, becomes infatuated with Fernando and is unwilling to let her sister have him.
title: Amor en silencio

overview: The story revolves around 5 youngsters and the world of motorcycling; the title is inspired by a song from Hispanic group Menudo.

overview: A spin-off sequel of the 1996 TV series "Sucupira". The story takes place when Sucupira Mayor Federico Valdivieso, who was thought gone and buried comes out of his grave, causing confussion and chaos among the town's citizens.

overview: The financially struggling Royals family's fortunes change when Markos Royal rescues a businesswoman who rewards him by making him chairman of her company.

overview: Two families, two worlds. On the surface, they are separated by a long distance, but in reality their destinies are closely linked and from a point on they become common. Dimitris and Alexandra are two young children, the former from a middle-class family, the latter a well-educated bigot. Their different upbringings do not stop the fatal attraction they feel as soon as they meet. The class difference would not be enough to keep them apart if the two children were not actually fraternal twins who were separated shortly after birth. Fate playing strange games brings Dimitris and Alexandra together. This event initiates rapid changes in the lives of the two families, since the guilty secrets, deep bitterness and intense loves of the past, buried for many years, now resurface.

overview: A Brazilian series, based on the play "The Taming of the Shrew" by William Shakespeare, which follows the story of Julião Petruchio, a rustic and determined man, and Catarina, a temperamental girl with an aversion to marriage.

overview: Three fathers grapple with personal crises while navigating the challenges of parenthood and unconditional love for their children in the series Señores Papis.
title: Señores Papis

overview: Amid the 1916 miners' strike on Serifos, a young miner follows his father's path in the dangerous tunnels while falling in love with the daughter of his enemy, as workers rise to demand dignity and humane conditions.

overview: After moving from a rural village to the big city to live with their grumpy uncle, three siblings navigate urban life, pursue music careers, and cause comedic chaos while uncovering deep family secrets and finding love.

overview: One of the world's most iconic harbours is also the scene of some of its most unpredictable police work. Sydney Harbour Cops takes viewers beyond the postcard views and onto the water with the NSW Police Force Marine Area Command, offering unprecedented access to the officers charged with keeping Sydney Harbour and the NSW coastline safe.
title: Sydney Harbour Cops

overview: Set in the untamed and rugged wilderness of Canada and in a big twist to the Australian version, this new spin off series will feature celebrities competing as pairs alongside relatives, loved ones or even fellow celebrities. The pairs will eat, compete and be eliminated together. Which pair will be victorious?

overview: How to Survive the End of the World examines terrifying and scientifically plausible doomsday scenarios by exploring six distinct, world-threatening events—flooding, freezing, continent-wide storm systems, a global volcanic cataclysm, a killer pandemic, and nano-technology run amok—and the methods by which humanity would fight to survive against grim odds.
title: How to Survive the End of the World

overview: A devoted mother agrees to a painful bargain with a guarded businessman to finance her son's medical treatment, only for their forced encounter to ignite an intense and unexpected love that challenges both of their deepest wounds.

overview: In 1960s Piraeus, two rival families are drawn into a destructive feud linked to the famed Porto Leone cabaret, where betrayal, forbidden ties, and hidden motives threaten to destroy them all.
title: Porto Leone: Στη γειτονιά με τα κόκκινα φανάρια

overview: Hack Along with GoldieBlox is a girl-powered DIY web series where host Goldie Blox leads kids through fun, trendy crafts, cooking projects, and seasonal activities that secretly teach foundational STEM and engineering concepts.
title: Hack Along with GoldieBlox

overview: What would you do if you lost everything in an instant? The love of your life, your father, your friends, your freedom? At twenty, Markos thought he had it all. Yet, those he trusted stripped him of everything, luring him into a deadly trap. Love, friendship, romance, betrayal, prison, money, power, revenge—varied emotions and circumstances, yet all ingredients of a life abruptly and treacherously severed in two by the ruthless hand of betrayal, only to be "reborn" two decades later with a different face and identity, but the same tormented soul.
title: Ο Τιμωρός

overview: A disgraced woman finds refuge on the island to raise her son, Giannos. Intelligent and perceptive, he grows up bearing a stigma, as the villagers treat him with scorn and suspicion, regarding him as a "bastard" and an "outsider." In his heart, the purest of feelings awakens for a girl unlike the others of her time: Margarita.
title: Οι Αθώοι

overview: The career of the distinguished judge Petros Dimitriou seems to be heading for success, with a forthcoming promotion. Everything takes a turn after his teenage son, Alkis, is involved in a hit-and-run accident, for which he is responsible.

overview: A fallen Taekwondo champion protects an autistic boy after his family is attacked, fleeing to her estranged mother's village, where buried secrets and a mysterious disappearance challenge their search for safety.
title: Το παιδί

overview: Relationship expert Paul C. Brunson meets survivors of toxic relationships to reveal the red flags and warning signs that turned love into control, manipulation and abuse.
title: Paul C. Brunson: Red Flag

overview: Following the tragic death of her parents in an attack fueled by obsessive love, a young woman returns years later to confront her past, unaware that the same silent enemy seeks to destroy her once again.
title: Háblame de amor

overview: Five celebrities and their dogs take on the world of competitive dog training, learning new skills, building on their relationships with their pets, and vying to be Wagging Rights champion.
title: Wagging Rights

overview: Actor Idris Elba charts the origins and history of underground racing and examines how the quest for high speed has affected modern motorsport and the cars of today.

overview: In Nafplio 2025, abandoned twins confront their mother - now married into a powerful family - forcing long-hidden secrets, forbidden loves, and a vengeful past to collide in a tale of betrayal and redemption.

overview: Yasemince delivers a routine family life of a hopeless middle class couple of which a housewife and a happy-go-lucky man struggle to adapt their lives into changing Istanbul metropolitan chaos. It is a comedy series that includes many sketches.

overview: In January 1998, this slice-of-life series premiered, changing the way stories were told on local television and immortalising two beloved characters: Roxy and Panigazzi. Featuring memorable performances by Mercedes Morán and Juan Leyrado, Gasoleros, its title a distinctly local term, reflects Argentine customs, habits, and neighbourhood culture through characters representing everyday people in the country's society.
title: Gasoleros

overview: A mockumentary about Alo and his colleagues at a highly competitive car dealership.
title: Alo

overview: When the city goes dark - literally - newly divorced Andres is faced with painful choices: whether to give his children the chance to see their mother in another city, or to keep them away from a world that is falling apart by the hour.
title: Pimeduses

overview: A Bahraini comedy drama series, featuring different stories of life in the Gulf during the 1940s and 1950s, by presenting the simple life that people lived at this time.

overview: It's mom, blogger, author and all-around funny lady Stefanie Wilder-Taylor in her hybrid of a show...more featuring commentary, monologues, discussions, hidden camera, mom-on-the-street and sketch comedy. In other words, it a load of laughs for a mom, by a mom!
title: Parental Discretion with Stefanie Wilder-Taylor

overview: The series introduced audiences to the worlds of boxing, garbage collection, and meatpacking plant work, while also generating excitement through the palpable chemistry between the lead actors, a connection that transcended the screen in every scene they shared. It gave rise to the unforgettable character of Guevara, a man striving to regain his standing in the boxing world, and Clara, a teacher grappling with her son's drug problem.
title: Campeones de la vida

overview: Cenas do Casamento portrays the daily lives of three couples from different generations living in the same building.
title: Cenas do Casamento

overview: A forbidden romance between two Mexican immigrants who cross illegally into the United States becomes complicated when she rises to fame as a music star and he is unjustly blamed for a crime.

overview: Rather than telling a single story, Campeones weaves together a series of interconnected tales based on the characters' family ties, friendships, and rivalries, aiming to paint a realistic portrait of a lower-middle-class neighbourhood in Mexico City. The situations presented are authentic and will resonate with viewers. It tells the story of the Duarte brothers: Ciro, a traditional family man who is about to retire from his job as a meatpacker, and Chucho, a boxing promoter who tries to encourage his nephew Valentín - Ciro's son - to dedicate himself fully to the sport. Meanwhile, Valentín will experience a story of love and heartbreak between Carla and his true love, Isabel.
title: Campeones de la vida

overview: Now Pepe Cadena finishes telling the story in which the most powerful drug traffickers in Colombia are strengthened but later fall while he and others dedicate themselves to the dangerous task of exposing them to collaborate with justice.
title: El cartel 2 - La guerra total

overview: Nesmrteľní (Immortals) is a Slovak television series featuring modern adaptations of classic literary works brought into contemporary settings.
title: Nesmrtelní

overview: 22, el loco follows Federico Falcone, a police officer caught in a complex love triangle with Laura, a fellow brigade member he has known since childhood, and Ana, a progressive children's rights lawyer working at a home for underprivileged kids, amid a gritty story of family expectations, crime, and passion.
title: 22, el loco

overview: My Life is a Lifetime Movie is an American reality television series that premiered on Lifetime on October 17, 2012.
title: My Life is a Lifetime Movie
